segments.name: Timberlands
segments.description: Grows and harvests timber on company-owned and managed timberlands, selling logs domestically and for export.
segments.evidence: Demand for sawlogs within our Timberlands segment is directly affected by domestic production of wood-based building products as well as export markets.

segments.name: Real Estate, Energy and Natural Resources
segments.description: Monetizes higher and better use timberlands and surface and subsurface assets, including through real estate sales and climate-related markets.
segments.evidence: Real Estate & ENR — Deliver premiums to timberland value by identifying and monetizing higher and better use lands and capturing the full value of surface and subsurface assets, including through our Climate Solutions business.

segments.name: Wood Products
segments.description: Manufactures wood products for residential, multi-family, repair and remodel, industrial and light commercial markets in the U.S. and Canada.
segments.evidence: Wood Products — Manufacture high-quality structural lumber, oriented strand board and engineered wood products, as well as deliver complementary building products for residential, multi-family, industrial and light commercial applications at competitive costs.

revenueModel.text: Customers in domestic and export building and construction markets pay Weyerhaeuser for logs, wood products and real estate or natural resource assets.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Wood Products segment primarily sells into the new residential building and repair and remodel markets.

changes.text: Beginning in the first quarter of 2026, the Real Estate, Energy and Natural Resources segment will be renamed Strategic Land Solutions.
changes.evidence: Beginning in the first quarter of 2026, the Real Estate, Energy and Natural Resources (Real Estate & ENR) segment will be renamed Strategic Land Solutions.
